slides.title: 4 dev stories you missed
slides.body: Nov 23 to 27, 2026. Swipe for the short version.

slides.title: Todoist confirms a data breach
slides.body: Stolen credentials let an attacker in. TechCrunch reports around 6% of customers' details were taken.
points: Rotate API tokens stored in apps

slides.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo
slides.body: An open-source Linux tool that uses eBPF 'shields' to block vulnerable code paths while patches roll out.
points: Lesson: eBPF is big in security

slides.title: Anthropic moved its API to Rust
slides.body: Its Messages API went from Python to Rust with about 70% less CPU per request. Claude wrote the first core version in about a week.
points: Lesson: testing took months, not code

slides.title: Ladybird browser hits alpha
slides.body: The independent Ladybird browser, with its own engine built from scratch, is downloadable for macOS and Linux.
points: Read its code to learn browsers

slides.title: Which one will you try?
slides.body: Reply with the slide number (2 to 5) in the comments. Want a project built on one of these ideas?

review.text: The team was very professional, supportive, and helpful throughout the entire project. They explained everything clearly.
